characters.summary: Rita Skeeter is a witch and journalist who uses a Quick-Quotes Quill and covert surveillance to gather information. In direct combat, she relies on standard low-level wizarding magic or her Animagus form.

weaknesses: Lacks notable combat training or offensive dueling feats
limitations: Relies heavily on stealth and surprise rather than direct confrontation

characters.summary: As an unregistered Beetle Animagus, Rita Skeeter can transform into a tiny insect to eavesdrop undetected.
